title: Dynamics 365 Business Central pricing
what_i_took_from_it: Essentials $80, Premium $110, Team Members $8 per user per month, paid yearly. Premium adds manufacturing.

title: How quality management works in Dynamics 365 Business Central
what_i_took_from_it: Built-in quality inspections arrived with 2026 release wave 1 (version 28), April 2026. Before that it took a partner product.

title: Dynamics 365 EDI: complete guide (September 2026)
what_i_took_from_it: Dynamics 365 has no complete EDI of its own. Most Business Central users add an extension or an outside EDI provider.

title: Lot and serial number tracking in Dynamics 365 Business Central
what_i_took_from_it: Business Central tracks lot, serial and package numbers without add-ons.

title: Plex: automotive manufacturing
what_i_took_from_it: Plex was designed by an auto supplier. MES, QMS and constraint-based scheduling are part of the platform.

title: Plex chosen by Somic America (press release, July 2024)
what_i_took_from_it: Describes Plex as one platform for ERP, MES, QMS and EDI.

title: Plex ERP profile
what_i_took_from_it: Cloud only, no on-premise option. MES and QMS are built in and share one database with the ERP. Described as easy to navigate.

title: Epicor Kinetic vs Plex Manufacturing Cloud: 2026 comparison
what_i_took_from_it: Kinetic from $100 per user per month, 5 to 10 months, $100K to $500K typical project. Plex from $120, 4 to 9 months, $100K to $600K.

title: Automotive industry page
what_i_took_from_it: Lists automotive EDI, tracking and traceability, and MMOG/LE compliance.

title: Kinetic production management suite brochure (copy hosted by a reseller)
what_i_took_from_it: Module list: data collection, advanced MES, quality assurance, QMS, advanced planning and scheduling, finite and constraint-based scheduling, EDI and demand management, REST services.

title: DPC enhances automotive EDI with AIM AutoCOR and Epicor Kinetic
what_i_took_from_it: An automotive plastics supplier on Kinetic added a partner product for EDI and barcode labels, working with Kinetic's demand management module.

title: Epicor CMS product page
what_i_took_from_it: Epicor also sells CMS, an ERP built only for automotive suppliers, with EDI for the major OEMs built in.

title: NetSuite pricing: the definitive guide
what_i_took_from_it: No public price list. About $999 a month base, $129 to $199 per full user, $15 to $25 self-service, implementation $25K to $150K, 5 to 8% increases at renewal.

title: Oracle NetSuite ERP review 2026
what_i_took_from_it: Multi-tenant cloud with two automatic updates a year. Pricing is base platform plus per user.

title: NetSuite for automotive
what_i_took_from_it: A NetSuite partner's automotive offer: EDI integration, quality management SuiteApp for PPAP and inspections, lot and serial control, release-driven planning.

title: NetSuite for manufacturing: the complete capability guide
what_i_took_from_it: Quality management is basic in NetSuite. EDI and shop-floor data collection come through integrations.

title: NetSuite manufacturing SuiteApps
what_i_took_from_it: Manufacturers add SuiteApps for scheduling, shop-floor data capture, quality, EDI and maintenance. NetSuite has a mobile app for manufacturing transactions.

title: Automotive ERP systems
what_i_took_from_it: Names QAD, Plex and Epicor Kinetic as the automotive picks and lists what suppliers need: 830 and 862 releases, CUM reconciliation, ASNs with customer labels, PPAP and APQP.

title: Must-have ERP features for the automotive industry (2014)
what_i_took_from_it: Describes Plex's release accounting module. Old, which is the point: it has been there a long time.

title: Epicor Kinetic for automotive
what_i_took_from_it: Lists EDI with OEMs and PPAP and APQP quality documents among Kinetic's automotive features. Cloud, on premise or hybrid.

title: Plex vs Epicor: manufacturing fit compared for 2026
what_i_took_from_it: Both Plex and Epicor Kinetic price by quote.

title: Licensing and pricing answers for Dynamics 365 Business Central
what_i_took_from_it: Current prices took effect November 1, 2025. Essentials already includes warehouse management.

title: Microsoft builds quality management for Business Central on Insight Works technology
what_i_took_from_it: The new quality module is a licensed subset of a partner's product.

title: NetSuite quality management guide
what_i_took_from_it: NetSuite quality management is a SuiteApp covering specifications, inspections and conformance actions.

title: Epicor Kinetic vs Plex Manufacturing Cloud for manufacturing
what_i_took_from_it: Plex scores weaker on procurement. Kinetic's new interface is still being extended to cover every older screen, and moving to its cloud from on-premise Epicor takes a re-implementation.
